notes.title: Just a few Improvements...
notes.content:
AI target detection improved(should shoot at the body of the tank more now)
Menu toggles improved 
map pictures added
Skip tutorial fixed(should not get stuck after skipping)
tutorial volume increased 
Projectile improvements
ballance pass for multiple weapons/components 
build mode is not on when you exit a tank, (still toggleable) 
zoom added for player 
player light toggle added
effect added to player build tool
offset of weapon table changed to not clip through wall

notes.title: Performace tweeks + player body position fix
notes.content: some small fixes and some big performance gains by removing complicated shadows for the tanks( for now)

notes.title: New tank loadout system + AI,network improvements .
notes.content:
New tank loadout system letting you save and apply loadouts between vehicles. 
It can be used to repair or replace any missing parts in one button. 

AI generation has been changed to (hopefully) not over-fill areas with AI.
Some small network improvements should allow for many more AI at once.

notes.title: Ballance and fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the 150mm cannon rounds explosion detetection to have more then 0 range (oops)
Lowered network updates for AI vehicles. 
Balance on some Component prices

notes.title: Fully Implamented recovery drones
notes.content:
Tagging debris for recovery will now send out a drone that costs 500 of each resource to produce. 
The drones can be destroyed by weapons fire so best to keep them covered.

notes.title: New Resource recovery drone + Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Added New resource recovery drone
Resources are now recovered while at a combat zone
The drone will need to be defended to get the resources (cost more to make more drones)  
Lowered recoil for 20mm cannon
Raised resistance of all armour
Fixed small bug - when a launcher got destroyed the controller still tried to fire it and ran an error.

notes.title: Added new missile shoot button
notes.content: "V" will now fire the next avalible missile nomatter what control group the lanchers are in.

notes.title: Improvemnts + small balance pass
notes.content:
Power balance pass (charge rate slowed down + weapon use changes) 
Recovering the tank (F11) from within the ship or the test ground will no longer clear the tank. so now you can propperly test.  
Improvements to the way projectiles detect hits right infront of the weapon.

notes.title: New weapon +bug fixes + Improvements
notes.content:
New WIP Tesla gun added. 
Fixed bug stoping AI bullets damaging components. 
Projectiles now inherit the speed of the gun. 
multiple tweeks to power generation.

notes.title: AI fix + Expolsion improvements
notes.content:
AI should no longer stop randomly
Missile explosions now propperly detect multiple damage points.

notes.title: Fixes+ Ai generation improvements
notes.content:
Synced Objective between players to everyone gets the direction arrow. 
Improvents to AI genation
limited amount of total AI across all maps
AI will now be taken randomly from all areas when its near the limit. 
Im provded grouping of units when spawn points are located for AI. 
Many more improvemnts to come.

notes.title: Multiple fixes + improvements to new weapons
notes.content: Added shoot delay variable to weapons.

notes.title: New weapon+fixes+Menu improvement
notes.content:
Turret hit box changed so it does not clip though the floor
Tank/turret mass tweeked to lower the COM
Changed research menu to a better layout
new weapon type created(railgun)
fixes for component/weapon fire groups.

notes.title: Tweeks+fixes
notes.content:
Missiles+bullets now hit and destroy other missiles. 
multiple tweeks and fixes

notes.title: New weapon +more improvments
notes.content:
Added WIP plasma cannon that uses power not ammo

Added capacitor component

Changed the power to use capacitors and change up over time. 

Made changes to damage detection to improve performance.

notes.title: Fixes+additions to test map
notes.content:
Added some test obstacles and practice targets to the test ground 

Tweeks to scanner/lockon to allow locking on to things other than AI

notes.title: More updates
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that would stop the game working after destroying a certain vehicle
Added a few more UI elemets to the tank.
Improved the Mission target arrow.

notes.title: Some Small UI updates
notes.content:
Updated some UI, 
More to do.
